d:
Under the arid salt flats in the Rann of Kutch lie the remains of the ancient Harappan city of Dholavira. Excavations have found mysterious artefacts including symbols of a language indecipherable. What else will be uncovered?
Kachchh ke ran men banjar namak ke registan ke niche daba huaa hai harappa sabhyata ke samay ka nagar dholavira | khudaee ke pashchat mile sanketon aur ek agyat lipi ko samajhne ka prayas abhi tak jari hai. kya is bhasha men chhipe hue hain is nagar ke patan se jure savalon ke javab ?
